repo_title: AI in Detonation Spray and Detonation Spray Coating
author: William Sun with help from OpenAI

analysis.executive_summary: AI in Detonation Spray and Detonation Spray Coating produced 111 tracked papers for 2026-08. The strongest signals were welding, coatings, that, this, were, with progress concentrated around methods, evaluation, and translational use cases.
notable_papers: Performance Enhancement of Railway Track Welding Electrodes via Natural Fiber-Based Composite Coatings
A hybrid machine learning framework for robust feasibility prediction of 3D mechanical designs using scalar and geometric features
The Effect of Vibration-Assisted Welding on the GMAW Welding Process on Porosity, Microstructure, and Hardness in 5083 Aluminium
HVAF spraying of NiTi coatings: Microstructure, phase transformation and shape memory behavior
Effects of Process Parameters on Microstructure and Properties of Welded Joints with Oscillating Laser-CMT Hybrid Welding of Die-Cast Aluminum/AA6061 Aluminum Alloy
field_progress: Research activity continued to move from isolated demonstrations toward benchmarked, reusable workflows.
Evaluation quality, data availability, and robustness remain recurring differentiators among papers.
The most useful papers combine domain knowledge with practical AI systems rather than generic model use alone.
open_questions: Which methods will reproduce across independent datasets and laboratories?
How should the field measure progress beyond narrow benchmark gains?
What governance, validation, and deployment practices are needed for reliable use?
analysis.outlook: The next period should be watched for stronger validation, more open artifacts, and clearer evidence of field-level impact.
